rows.note: Use 招數 as the all-purpose everyday term for a ploy or stratagem.

example.english: They've used this gambit again to pressure me into giving them a raise.
example.traditional: 佢今次又出呢招數，想逼我加人工。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 jau6 ceot1 ne1 ziu1 sou3 soeng2 bik1 ngo5 gaa1 jan4 gung1

rows.note: Use 花招 when the ploy is intended to sound sneaky or deceptive.

example.english: Don't fall for his gambit; he just wants to trick you into signing the contract.
example.traditional: 唔好信佢嗰啲花招，佢只係想呃你簽約。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 go2 di1 faa1 ziu1 keoi5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 ngaak1 nei5 cim1 joek3

rows.note: Use 棄兵開局 specifically for a chess opening that sacrifices material for an advantage.

example.english: I used a gambit in this game to gain the initiative.
example.traditional: 呢盤棋我用棄兵開局，搏取主動。
example.jyutping: ne1 pun4 kei4 ngo5 jung6 hei3 bing1 hoi1 guk6 bok3 ceoi2 zyu2 dung6
